theorem: Every accepted node is an outward Krawczyk-certified stationary point on its pseudo-arclength hyperplane. Opposite signed paths with the same uniform amplitude and Fourier mode meet through their exact certified uniform fold, giving thirty fold edges. All certified boxes belonging to distinct fold pairs are disjoint by the displayed positive coordinate clearance. Therefore the finite certified incidence graph has thirty components; this is a theorem about the sampled boxes and exact fold links, not about untraced global branches.
